map.白带清洁度(镜检)分级器 使用指南: Vaginal Discharge Cleanliness (Microscopy) Grader — User Guide
map.根据镜检上皮细胞、白细胞、杆菌与球菌比例自动判定阴道清洁度Ⅰ—Ⅳ度，用于妇科白带: Automatically determine vaginal cleanliness grades I–IV from microscopy of epithelial cells, white blood cells, bacilli and cocci ratios, for quick routine grading of vaginal discharge.
map.白带常规按线索细胞/Nugent 评分判读细菌性阴道病（BV）程度。: Routine discharge testing uses clue cells/Nugent scoring to grade bacterial vaginosis (BV) severity.
map.教学演示涂片评分标准。: Teaching demo of smear scoring standards.
map.：乳酸杆菌少、线索细胞多，Nugent 7-10 分判为 BV 阳性；0-3 正: : few lactobacilli and many clue cells, a Nugent score of 7-10 indicates BV positive; 0-3 normal, 4-6 intermediate. The tool gives a grade and follow-up advice.
map.评分高就要用药吗？: Does a high score require medication?
map.有症状或孕期需治疗，无症状中间型可观察；具体由妇科医师定。: Treatment is needed with symptoms or in pregnancy; an asymptomatic intermediate type can be observed. The final call rests with the gynecologist.
map.过度冲洗可能破坏菌群加重，建议规范诊治。: Excessive douching can disrupt the flora and worsen it; seek proper diagnosis and treatment.
map.能替代妇科检查吗？: Can it replace a gynecological exam?
map.不能，评分是辅助，诊断结合症状、pH 与镜检由医师判定。: No. The score is an aid; diagnosis combines symptoms, pH and microscopy, determined by a physician.
